name: ISS bubble growth benchmark
description: A benchmark image dataset and evaluation protocol for measuring bubble detection, segmentation and growth analysis in subcooled boiling experiments conducted on the ISS.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) / Intersection over Union (IoU) for detection/segmentation; MAE for growth-rate estimation
general_score_metric: mAP / IoU for detection/segmentation; MAE for growth estimation
reputation: A specialized, domain-specific benchmark for boiling/bubble analysis in microgravity with modest adoption among fluid-mechanics and space experiment researchers.
notes: Domain-specific, non-LLM benchmark; dataset sizes can be limited and labels may require domain expertise; potential class imbalance and varied imaging conditions due to experimental setups on the ISS.
